start_date.summary: Reuters reports strike and protest camp began Sep 9, 2024, before assigned month.

activity_in_month.summary: On Oct 1 Reuters reports more than 1,000 workers on strike and a street march near Chennai; the march is an action within the existing strike campaign.

state_target.summary: Wage and union-recognition demands principally directed at Samsung; whether state labor policy was a target is unresolved.

episode_continuity.summary: Event start predates October; this record avoids creating an October-onset observation.

description: Samsung workers’ strike/protest started Sept 9 and was still active at the start of October. Oct 1 march is kept as continuation; no new October candidate due earlier onset.
open_questions: Did an Oct 1 street march constitute a distinct action, or part of the Sep 9 campaign?
Were workers demanding a state labor-policy decision, or only employer bargaining?
When did the campaign end? No exact closeout source captured in this unit.
